slices.focus: The rushed software go-live causes payer table mapping errors and auth carryover failures, reversing months of denial gains.
slices.summary: Two weeks past go-live, claim edits fire off wrong payer tables and authorizations don't carry over, reversing months of denial-reduction gains. Kelli builds a marked-up evidence packet (screenshots, remits, claim IDs) for Monica to take to the vendor, and structures it into three buckets: revenue-blocking defects, false denials, and workflow annoyances. She considers whether rollback is necessary and struggles with insomnia and irritability spilling into home life.
